rationale: Select the registered structure family because this objective has an original bound ligand reference and local receptor geometry. The ligand anchor and RMS restraint use only the original bound pose; the contact and repulsion terms use the receptor crop and untyped geometric distances, so they are geometric proxies rather than affinity evidence. These moderate allowed settings are hypotheses for testing: the supplied evidence contains no affinity labels or generated outcomes and cannot establish an optimum. No lineage, temporal, elite-geometry, or history-matching information is available in this ablation.
failure_modes: The native-pose restraint may preserve a bound geometry that is not optimal for final predicted pIC50 or may limit useful graph transitions.
Untyped center-distance contacts may reward geometries without favorable chemical interactions; short distances alone do not establish clashes.
The receptor crop omits the rest of the receptor environment, and no generated-state or affinity-label evidence supports predicting enrichment or target improvement.
The selected weights are permitted design hypotheses, not validated optima; whole-scalar rescaling may have little effect under gradient normalization.
